notes: Study 1a and the US (western) population are identifiable, but the description and locator do not identify high-SES versus low-SES condition or a particular contrast. The paper reports two separate south–north one-sample tests for this population; choosing one would require an unsupported target assignment. The supplied p. 44 locator does not correspond to the published article pagination (360–369). Printed candidates only, not assigned values: High-SES north-versus-zero test: t(39) = 3.34, p < .01, Cohen’s d = 0.53. Low-SES south-versus-zero test: t(39) = 2.00, p = .05, Cohen’s d = 0.32. The combined-population SES × population interaction is F(1, 176) = 20.39, p < .001, partial eta-squared = 0.10; this is not a population-specific test. West–east tests are also reported on pp. 362–363, but the supplied description does not establish them as the target. No conversions or N derivations performed. Only original es_value_o and pval_value_o were assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Target PDF page 3 visually inspected; page 4 inspected for continuation/context.
